top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single well-bounded invention to Katori and Ye: magic-wavelength lattice trapping of many neutral atoms, free of Doppler, recoil and net light shifts, realised at 10^-18 fractional uncertainty and reproduced by independent laboratories. The two-name allocation matches the concept and the decisive realisation, and the citation scope separates it from the 2005 and 2012 prizes (ensemble interrogation in an engineered trap, not the comb or single-system control). Remaining doubts are overlap with earlier prizes and omitted groups, which weigh less than the maturity and clarity of the achievement; no award is a worse outcome than this.
